title: Student Transportation Services Bus Pass Schedule: Pass Requirement, Pass Fees and Free Replacements
content:
Every Student Transportation Services rider badges on with a district bus pass. The pass figures by transportation type:

| Transportation type | Bus pass required | Fee for the first pass of the school year | Fee for each replacement pass | Replacement passes per assignment per school year issued without the fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 0 |
| Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 0 |
| Regular Route Eligibility | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 0 |
| Hazardous Route Eligibility | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 0 |
| Choice Program Hub Shuttle | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 0 |
| McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 2 |
| Special Education Transportation | yes | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 2 |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A Special Education Transportation rider's first and second replacements in the school year carry no fee; a third replacement that year costs 5.00 USD.
- A Regular Route Eligibility rider's first replacement of the year costs 5.00 USD.
